meta.title: Groups and ratios
meta.description: Ratios and privileges of the Personal, Pro and Enterprise groups. Billed price = official price × group ratio.

hero.title: Groups and ratios
hero.subtitle: Every API key is bound to a group. Billed price = official price × group ratio, with no subscription fees.

ratio.title: How ratios work
ratio.subtitle: The same model costs differently across groups only by its ratio.
ratio.baseNote: The official price is the list price published by the model provider.

items.q1: How do editions relate to groups?
items.a1: Each edition is a group. An API key uses the channels, availability target and ratio of the group it is bound to.
items.q2: Can one account use multiple groups?
items.a2: Yes. Each API key is bound to its own group, and one account can create multiple keys for different purposes.
items.a3: Ratio changes are announced on this page in advance; consumption already incurred is not affected.
items.q4: Can organization members choose their own group?
items.a4: Members can only create keys within the group range authorized by the organization admin.
items.a5: Contact sales — channels, ratios and availability are set by contract.
